title: Nature and Biodiversity: Cause and Result with -va/-ve
grammar: Cause and Result with the -va/-ve Participle
goal: I can link a cause and its result with a participle (*kárt okozva, vizet visszatartva*).
I can name the main terms of ecology (*biodiverzitás, élőhelyfragmentáció, vízvisszatartás*).
I can say what an ecosystem service is.

sections.title: Unit 14: Ecological System Dynamics, Energy Transition & Green Taxonomy
body: Texts about the environment, energy and green finance in Hungarian use long compound nouns (*élőhelyfragmentáció*, *karbontalanítás*, *zöldrefestés*), participles that add a result to a clause, and the language of rules and obligations.

This unit follows Fekete István's novel *Tüskevár* (1957), set in the Berek marshland near the Kis-Balaton. You will learn to read and write about nature, the energy transition, green finance and nuclear safety.
